evidence.command:
cd /tmp/p42base/src && python3 - <<'PY'
import re, glob
files = sorted(glob.glob('lib/std/*.h.ct')) + [
  'examples/38_ecosystem_reuse/src/eco.h.ct',
  'test/modules/p29_generic_struct/shapes.h.ct',
  'test/modules/p31_cross_unit_owned/elem.h.ct',
  'test/modules/p34_inherent/lib.h.ct']
def strip(t):
    t = re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', lambda m: '\n'*m.group(0).count('\n'), t, flags=re.S)
    t = re.sub(r'//[^\n]*', '', t)
    return t
allrows=[]; per={}
for f in files:
    lines = strip(open(f, encoding='utf-8').read()).split('\n')
    in_impl=False; trait=False; owner='?'; n=0
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines, 1):
        if not in_impl:
            m = re.match(r'^impl\b(.*)\{', ln)
            if m:
                in_impl=True; hdr=m.group(1); trait = ' for ' in hdr
                h = hdr.split(' for ')[0].strip()
                h = re.sub(r'^<[^>]*>\s*', '', h).strip()
                mm = re.match(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)', h); owner = mm.group(1) if mm else '?'
            continue
        if re.match(r'^\}\s*$', ln):
            in_impl=False; trait=False; owner='?'; continue
        if trait: continue
        if not ln.startswith('    ') or ln.startswith('     '): continue
        s = ln.strip()
        if not s or s.startswith('/*') or s.startswith('//'): continue
        if ';' in s: continue
        if re.match(r'^(if|while|for|switch|return|else)\b', s): continue
        m = re.match(r'^(.+?)\(([^()]*)\)\s*\{?\s*$', s)
        if not m: continue
        head = m.group(1).strip()
        if head.endswith('='): continue
        nm = re.search(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)$', head)
        if not nm: continue
        name=nm.group(1); ret=head[:nm.start()].strip()
        n+=1; allrows.append((f,i,owner,name,ret))
    per[f]=n
print("PER-FILE:")
for f in files: print(f"  {f} = {per[f]}")
std=sum(v for f,v in per.items() if f.startswith('lib/std/'))
oth=sum(v for f,v in per.items() if not f.startswith('lib/std/'))
print(f"\nSTD={std} OTHER={oth} ALL={std+oth}")
names=[r[3] for r in allrows if r[3] in ('retain','release')]
print(f"\nNAME_MATCH retain|release = {len(names)} (retain={names.count('retain')}, release={names.count('release')})")
for f,i,o,nm,rt in allrows:
    if nm in ('retain','release'): print(f"  {f}:{i} owner={o} {rt} {nm}()")
from collections import defaultdict
by=defaultdict(lambda: {'rs':[],'rel':[]})
for f,i,owner,name,ret in allrows:
    if name=='retain':
        b=re.match(r'^(?:struct\s+)?([A-Za-z_]\w*)',ret)
        if b and b.group(1)==owner: by[owner]['rs'].append(f"{f}:{i}")
    elif name=='release': by[owner]['rel'].append(f"{f}:{i}")
prot={o:v for o,v in by.items() if v['rs'] and v['rel']}
print(f"\nPROTOCOL owners={sorted(prot)} methods={sum(len(v['rs'])+len(v['rel']) for v in prot.values())}")
for o in sorted(by):
    print(f"  {o}: retain_self={len(by[o]['rs'])} release={len(by[o]['rel'])} -> {'PROTOCOL' if by[o]['rs'] and by[o]['rel'] else 'NOT_PROTOCOL'}")
PY
